itemList.description: Core Scope of Work (SOW): The contractor is completely responsible for the routine operation, preventive servicing, and emergency breakdown repair of the entire park infrastructure. A) Luminaries & Fixtures: Maintenance and replacement of LED pathway lights, bollards, high-mast towers, focus spotlights, decorative pole lights, and underwater Core Scope of Work (SOW): The contractor is completely responsible for the routine operation, preventive servicing, and emergency breakdown repair of the entire park infrastructure. A) Luminaries & Fixtures: Maintenance and replacement of LED pathway lights, bollards, high-mast towers, focus spotlights, decorative pole lights, and underwater fountain lights, LED tubes/Bulbs/LED streetlights, post top Fittings and It also includes the repairs and maintenance of light fittings/fans of buildings inside the park. Including any other type of lights inside the park. B) Feeder Pillars & Distribution Boards: Regular cleaning, checking panel tightness, and replacing faulty MCBs, ELCBs, contactors, timers, and bus bars. C) Cabling & Underground Wiring: Troubleshooting earth faults, insulation testing, repairing damaged underground armored cables, and straight-jointing. Replacing any burnt-out cables of length up to 30 meter D) Automation Systems: Maintenance of digital or astronomical timer switches E) Earthing Infrastructure: Periodic watering, salt-charcoal recharging, and testing earth-pit resistance to protect the public from leakage current. Including periodic checking of Earthing & other electrical faults & rectify the faults if any and insulating all the conducting material. Maintenance Schedules & Deliverables: To avoid extended dark periods in public spaces, a strict timeline matrix must be enforced: Maintenance Type: Routine/Daily: Every 24 Hours: Night patrolls, turning lights on/off, scanning for non-functional bulbs, and immediate replacement. conduct daily walk-throughs to identify vandalized fixtures, leaning poles,exposed wiring and rectification/restoration Preventive: Monthly: Cleaning insects/dust from polycarbonate covers, measuring earth resistance, and tightening connections, Breakdown: As Needed: Attending to blackouts, short circuits, or storm damage within standard SLAs (typically 4-12 hours) Maximum Burnout Rate: The contractor must ensure a minimum of 95% to 98% operational efficiency of all lights at any given time, All the lights and fans and electrical equipments inside the crematorium,Labor Compliance: Strict enforcement of local minimum wage laws, mandatory Provident Fund (PF), and Employee State Insurance (ESI) for all deployed park workers
